# Remaining unit events: finalization research, 29 October 2026

No additional unit adjustment is supported by this pass. All 15 researched histories remain blocked. This is a bounded evidence result, not proof that the missing original notices do not exist.

The prior continuation event and UTI dossiers, committed continuation queue, and source-quality dossier were read first. Previously completed PR73 actions were not repeated. Production code, source archives, source history and original warnings were not changed. No MFAPI source calls, AMFI downloads, collector, browser login or source mutations were performed.

## New primary evidence

The issuer's NSE-hosted March 2026 consolidated SSD establishes both exact JM identities on physical PDF page 5, printed page 1, fields 28 and 29. The page was rendered and visually inspected.

URL: https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/trading_security/mf/pdf/JM_18032026140719_JMFinancialMutualFund.pdf

Original file: `jm-nse-ssd-2026.pdf`, 1,009,794 bytes. SHA256: `4b04b1a50cd68b1b7e9548d9cd8bbd1f403a21ad4a3b65f9d7cec2784205d2f0`.

Field 29 excerpt: “JM Overnight Fund (Regular) - Growth-147836,JM Overnight Fund - (Direct) - Growth-147837”. Field 28 maps Regular Growth to INF192K01LX4 and Direct Growth to INF192K01MB8. Both are within the JM Overnight Fund table, not neighboring schemes. This independently strengthens identity beyond the old NCCL mapping. It does not contain historical conversion terms or reconcile the raw 13 December 2019 boundary with the original annual report's 14 December effective date.

## New archive lead and access evidence

The primary Baroda-side historical notice index is https://www.barodabnpparibasmf.in/baroda-archivedownloads/notice-cum-addenda . Its publicly indexed page explicitly advertises years 2009–2022, including 2011. This is distinct from the BNP archive: using BNP 2011 reports would risk matching a different historical issuer lineage. Search-reader capture is preserved in `baroda-search-reader.json`. The page opens at 2022, and the year choices are not links exposed by the search reader. Ordinary direct TLS retrieval returned HTTP503, so this pass could not extract the 2011 filter endpoint or original February notice. A future successful direct read of this same public index should expose the site's normal year selector request; no guessed endpoint or bypass was attempted.

The Baroda-side scheme financial archive https://www.barodabnpparibasmf.in/baroda-archivedownload/financial-annual-reports advertises 2021, 2020 and 2004–2008, omitting 2011 in the returned selector. The similarly named `/archivedownload/financial-annual-reports` advertises 2011 but is BNP's historical lineage and is not automatically evidence for Baroda Pioneer.

The public PGIM 2019–20 audited annual report remains a concrete retrieval lead: https://online.pgimindiamf.com/navlinks/Downloads/Docs/PGIMIndia_FullFinancialsAR20.pdf . Search indexing confirms it is the scheme annual report and returns accounting-policy/performance excerpts; no indexed excerpt established a dated denomination conversion. Direct original download and search opening failed (HTTP503 / inaccessible). Thus no original-byte hash or event quote is asserted.

Public JM issuer SSD and NAV-page retrieval each returned HTTP406. The independently published NSE issuer SSD succeeded and is the identity evidence above. No access restriction was bypassed. Default sandbox sockets were unavailable; read-only network escalation enabled ordinary public downloads. TLS verification remained enabled.

## Explicit unresolved dispositions

| 100723,112077 | Original dated UTI Money Market conversion notice for August 2009; identities already improved in prior dossier | Keep blocked; shared 100x curve does not supply terms |
| 102532 | Original dated UTI Floating Rate conversion notice for April 2006; 2010 SID current face value does not date conversion | Keep blocked |
| 102540 | Original dated UTI Liquid/Treasury Advantage conversion notice for April 2007 and exact historical identity continuity | Keep blocked |
| 102009 | Exact primary numeric-code/current-ISIN chain resolving prior NCCL BB4 versus issuer BC2 contradiction; legal and raw boundary dates also differ | Keep blocked; modern secondary listings are not a resolution |
| 101619,101802,103340,103633 | Primary dated ICICI November 2009 conversion and complete exact affected-plan historical linkage | Keep blocked; annual investor holdings prove at most denomination within a period |
| 147600,147606 | Primary dated PGIM September 2019 conversion; old/new denomination bracket is insufficient | Keep blocked; annual report inaccessible |
| 147836,147837 | Reconciliation of annual effective 14 December versus raw first new NAV on 13 December 2019 | Keep blocked; new exact primary identity obtained only |
| 101408,111704 | Original February 2011 Baroda Pioneer Liquid event and exact legacy/current option bridge | Keep blocked; correct historical notice archive found but original notice not retrieved |

## Full-history implications

`full-history-diagnostic.json` independently rechecks all 15 complete immutable fixtures: 71,636 observations. Every fixture SHA256 equals the committed continuation queue. Every history has exactly one >40% raw move, zero duplicate dates and zero nonpositive/nonfinite NAVs. Applying the hypothesized factor to every earlier observation would remove each numerical discontinuity, but every entry explicitly has `diagnosticOnly: true`, `authorizedAdjustment: false`, and `keep_blocked` disposition. Factors and precise boundaries are recorded as arithmetic diagnostics, never evidence of a corporate action. No current source freshness or active-scope revalidation is implied.

Search engine 1 was used for the primary financial evidence search and verification. Searches covered exact effective-date variants, old scheme names, face value/consolidation wording, historical annuals, current issuer SSDs, and issuer/regulator/exchange domains. Recent third-party pages labeling a 100:1 adjustment were treated solely as leads, not confirmation.

# Remaining multi-jump cases: bounded primary-source search

## Invesco 116077 / 120531: keep blocked

Exact missing evidence is issuer/exchange-published 25 October 2019 NAV for the Gold ETF Fund of Fund Regular Growth (INF205K01FA4) and Direct Growth (INF205K01NJ9), respectively. Source values 0.18810 and 0.19160 produce a near-total loss and reversal; that pattern does not determine a replacement NAV.

The official fund page surfaced in search, but a direct fetch returned HTTP 403. The historical NAV link `/nav-and-dividends` also returned HTTP 403; the web search tool resolved it to the new official `/nav-idcw` page, whose direct fetch also returned HTTP 403. No access-control workaround or repeated request to a failed URL was used. Attempt records are saved as invesco-page-attempt.json, invesco-nav-attempt.json and additional-primary-attempts.json. The first attempt record was created before the exception was added, so its file contains the URL only; the tool response records the 403.

An indexed official fund page includes a normalized wealth series with 25 October 2019 value 21,012.01. It cannot safely establish either required NAV: its surrounding figures and the issuer's October 2019 factsheet correspond to the underlying Gold ETF series rather than the target FoF's saved adjacent NAVs. Do not rescale it into a replacement fund NAV or infer one plan from the other.

Primary lead URLs:

- https://www.invescomutualfund.com/our-funds/fund-of-funds/invesco-india-gold-etf-fund-of-fund/rggp
- https://www.invescomutualfund.com/our-funds/fund/fund-of-funds/invesco-india-gold-etf-fund-of-fund/rggp
- https://invescomutualfund.com/nav-and-dividends (web resolver redirects to https://www.invescomutualfund.com/nav-idcw)
- https://invescomutualfund.com/docs/default-source/default-document-library/factsheet---october-2019.pdf?sfvrsn=0 (month-end data is not the missing 25 October observation)

Targeted searches of issuer and exchange domains did not yield an exact-date NAV report for these two options. No AMFI download, MFAPI fetch, mutation or correction was performed.

## ICICI 102135: keep blocked

Exact missing evidence is issuer/exchange-published 2 January 2008 NAV for the exact current identity ICICI Prudential Aggressive Hybrid Active FOF - Regular Plan - Growth, ISIN INF109K01852, including a defensible historical scheme-name binding if the publication uses a former name. The saved value is 19.29330, between 1 January 37.10370 and 3 January 37.17640. Adjacent values cannot establish the correct January 2 NAV.

Official NAV page https://www.icicipruamc.com/mutual-fund/nav-%26-dividend returned 200 and its observed public JavaScript bundle `/static/js/index.Br5Xr9Iq.js` returned 200. The bundle contains a download API template on apimf.icicipruamc.com: `/fs/v1/funds/download/:componentType`, with filters/sorts/component/fileType body, but this bounded investigation did not establish the exact component/filter contract and historical option identifier required for a safe precise request. No guessed API call, authentication change or credential access was made. Original page/script bytes and hashes are retained in icici-attempt.json and additional-primary-attempts.json.

Targeted issuer/exchange searches did not identify the exact 2008 dated value. This is a concrete remaining evidence gap, not proof that the publication is unavailable or that the low source value is valid. Leave both source discontinuities and original value visible and blocked.

## Supported additions from this pass

The ABSL pair is independently supported by exact dated issuer CSV data and separate option identity mapping; see absl-review.md and absl-correction-candidates.json. Four normalized primary proof records (BOI pair revalidated from preceding research, ABSL pair newly discovered here) are consolidated in four-supported-primary-proof.json. No production edits are included in this research directory.
